text.en:
Gain <pve 35% /> <pvp [15%] /> Increased Weapon Damage for <pve 6 /> <pvp [3] /> seconds after Void Invisibility ends.

Finishers while Invisible apply Volatile to enemies within [?] metres, and grant both you and allies within 24 metres a Reserve Overshield and 375% Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate until either dying or using Class Ability.

Reserve Overshield is activated when you cast your Class Ability, granting you a 40 HP <void/>Void Overshield for 10 seconds.
text.zh-chs:
在虚空隐身结束后的 <pve 6 /> <pvp [3] /> 秒内，获得 <pve 35% /> <pvp [15%] /> 武器伤害增加。

隐身期间的终结技会在 [?] 米范围内的敌人施加挥发性效果，并使24米范围内的你和盟友获得备用护盾和375%额外的基础职业能力再生速度，直到死亡或使用职业能力。

备用护盾在你施放职业能力时激活，为你提供40 HP的虚空护盾，持续10秒。

text.en:
Upon Void Invisibility ending:
Grants Volatile Rounds for <pve 10 /> <pvp [3] /> seconds.

On Finishers while affected by Void Invisibility:
• Grants 35% Increased Damage for 6 seconds
• Grants you and allies within 24 meters the Reserve Overshield buff

Reserve Overshield:
• Grants 375% Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate
• Grants the user a 40 HP Void Overshield for 10 seconds on Class Abiliy usage
• Buff is removed on Class Ability usage
